objective: Proof: for each fixed linked difference pattern the rerouting is injective, so collisions come only from different patterns; the arm inequality for the axes u and u + e_i together is equivalent to bounding a two-by-two minor by the pairs agreeing at terminal i plus cross terms, with the cross-term marginals always positive by co-independence; explicit gadgets show that the bound fails per partner solution, per image pattern, for one-sided path-flip matchings and without the agreeing terms, so any proof must be global.
status: Proved by LOOP-HUB-20261025-001B-P001: rerouting is injective for each fixed linked difference pattern, so the arm inequality holds whenever patterns map injectively (as on trees); for both axes u and u + e_i it is equivalent to bounding a two-by-two minor by the agreeing and cross terms, with the cross marginals always positive; explicit two- and three-knot gadgets satisfy it but break the per-partner, per-image-pattern, path-flip and minor strengthenings, so any proof for gadgets with cycles must be global. The conjecture itself remains open.
title: What a proof of the arm inequality must contain
